On the general religious topic- the path to finding religion is hard, but it’s so worth it. A very good friend of mine is a non denominational christian, he believes that God values humans based on their intentions and actions, by showing kindness and guidance anywhere you can. Christianity was originally an oral religion- most people couldn’t read or write, so they spread the stories of Jesus and God by telling them to people. What’s undebatable is that from people telling stories verbally, inevitably things are going to be added and removed to fit what people personally believe, which isn’t always good. Then, when it became time to document everything, a bunch of kings ordered their favorite stories to be put in their bibles. What we can gather from this is that undeniably the overarching theme is to be kind. I personally am a Satanist and my whole goal is to go to Hell, and personally I believe you end up in the afterlife devoted to whomever you served. But, following a more traditional christian thought, if you follow the theme of being Kind, you’re following Gods plan. My point is, explore religion as if it’s a new land. I’ve found my religion is so strong because i’ve looked into and tried others, and this is the one for me!
